title: Message
description: A GD-92 message as decoded by an MTA and used within a node

envelope.description: The message envelope, contains detils used to route the message body

source.description: The GD-92 address of the message originator

destinations.description: list of destination GD-92 address ranges the message should be sent to

sequence.description: Sequence number of this message to the source+desinations tuple

message-type.description: GD-92 message number. The format of the message property is determined by this value

ack-required.description: $true if this message requires an ACK/NAK

bcc.description: a 8 bit unsigned BCC calculated on the raw bytes of the whole message less the last byte that is this BCC value. Avalable only if the uuencoded-binary-message-buffer is not empty

message.description: JSON object mapped to the specific message type decoded

uuencoded-binary-message-buffer.description: a UUencoded Base64 string of the WHOLE gd-92 message buffer recieved by an MTA

comms-address.title: A GD-92 comms address
comms-address.description: A GD-92 comms address, specifies a brigade, node and port number
